stock.description: Sino Hotels (Holdings) Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in managing and operating hotels throughout Hong Kong and Singapore. Its Hong Kong hospitality portfolio features establishments like Royal Pacific Hotel & Towers, Conrad Hong Kong, City Garden Hotel, The Olympian Hong Kong, Hong Kong Gold Coast Hotel, and The Pottinger Hong Kong. In Singapore, the company oversees The Fullerton Hotel and The Fullerton Bay Hotel. Beyond its hotel ventures, it also runs recreational facilities, including the Gold Coast Yacht & Country Club. The company's business scope extends to offering nominee and financial services, as well as participating in share and bond investments. Furthermore, Sino Hotels manages a wide array of dining venues, such as restaurants and bars like Gradini Ristorante E Bar Italiano, Satay Inn (at Royal Pacific Hotel and Hong Kong Gold Coast Hotel), YUÈ, Lobby Lounge, Gold Coast Prime Rib, and Pierside Bar & Restaurant, alongside cafes and delis including Cafe Lagoon, Café on the PARK, and Park Deli. The firm is headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
